newsitem.title: USA: Basswood won't seek 10 pct of SC Bancorp.
newsitem.headline: Basswood won't seek 10 pct of SC Bancorp.

text.p: A group including Basswood Partners L.P. said Friday it no longer plans to acquire 10 percent or more of SC Bancorp's outstanding shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it changed its plans "in order to pursue other strategies for maximizing shareholder value."

The group also withdrew the Notice of Change in Bank Control that they filed with the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco regarding the potential purchase of additional shares in the Anaheim, Calif., bank.
The Basswood group holds 730,499 common shares in the bank or 9.77 percent of its outstanding.
